### Fixes

- **Chat list dates.** Fixed years like 58757 in the chat list: core timestamps were converted to milliseconds twice.
- **Send directly on Android.** The built-in mini-app is now bundled natively and checked before sending, so it no longer posts an empty message or opens a "not found" window. If it can't start, you get an error and nothing is sent.

### Improvements

- **Edit captions.** You can edit the caption of your own image, video, voice and file messages, just like text messages. Media sent without a caption still can't get one added (core limitation).
